summary: Check whether 115/179 is a parallel attestation rather than the source of the quotation.
rationale: The quoted sentence begins azzé l-u=kōn (“he went to the tent”), which is absent from supplied 115/179. That verse instead says U sayfayḏe kale mʕalqo (“his sword is there hanging”), so it supports the participle but not the full quotation. The suggested 115/178 has neither the hanging-sword clause nor the tent scene and is not a justified replacement. The Prym–Socin references have no supplied citation evidence to resolve which quotation they support.

summary: Restore the missing article in “zur Erde”.
rationale: The phrase means returning to the ground: zur Erde. The supplied corpus translation repeats the same evident missing-r slip.

summary: Correct “ein lange Weile” to “eine lange Weile”.
rationale: Weile is feminine, requiring eine. The supplied edition translation contains the same obvious dropped-e slip.
